classification.classification_reason: The article is about the Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) and its actions regarding encroachments on roads.

content.title: Residents urge GCC to remove encroachments on roads in congested areas
content.caption: Residents call for removal of encroachments on congested stretches in commercial areas like T. Nagar, following a recent Madras High Court direction.
